about: Planted meaning errors in honest Dutch drafts (r1 after the fix, all passed the judge). Each planted version changes the Dutch only, with one edit; the drafter's honest English stays as it was, which is the case a reader without Dutch cannot see. 'pattern' is the English a faithful back-translation of the planted version must contain, written before any run. Caught = held back by any check. Written by Claude Opus 5.5, not a native speaker.

examples.dutch: Beste, U kunt uw nieuwe btw-nummer zelf aanpassen onder Instellingen → Bedrijfsgegevens. Het nieuwe nummer wordt dan gebruikt op toekomstige facturen. Met vriendelijke groet, Team Roosterly
examples.english: Hello, you can change your new VAT number yourself under Settings → Company details (Instellingen → Bedrijfsgegevens). The new number is then used on future invoices. Kind regards, Team Roosterly.
